description: Get the latest rate of forex currency pairs (EUR/USD, USD/JPY), up to 25 a call: last trade price and its UTC time, the 24-hour change, and the 24-hour volume (in the first currency), high and low. Rates are one exchange's trades, not an interbank or official reference rate; for official daily rates use GetEconomicIndicator. A thinly traded pair shows an old last-trade time; that is its real last trade. A pair asked the other way round (USD/EUR) answers with the listed pair. Pro reads real time, Plus 15 minutes delayed, Free gets an upgrade note (daily candles are in GetForexPrices). ListForexPairs lists the pairs.

pairs.description: Currency pairs (max 25), e.g. EUR/USD, GBPUSD, USD-JPY
